scope: Commit SHA binding for verification records and doc-link anchor validation
summary: Every verification record now carries the 40-hex SHA of the commit that introduced it (445 records backfilled from git --diff-filter=A provenance; one pre-existing malformed JSON repaired). scripts/verify-record.mjs enforces the binding in --check mode and stamps new records with git HEAD; it is wired into pnpm check. scripts/check-doc-links.mjs additionally validates #anchors against GitHub-style heading slugs (inline code, CJK, dedupe suffixes) after a negative self-test. The adapter-fastify suite also grew from 14 to 21 tests covering create/update command modes, a registry query path, multi-mount identity isolation and the query response firewall.
boundaries: The bound SHA refers to the tree the verification ran on; the record's own commit is its successor. Legacy records are bound to the commit that first added them. The seven skipped core tests require a real cosign binary. CI results for pushed commits are confirmed in the GitHub Actions page.
